name: std::swap(std::flat_multimap)
intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::flat_multimap. Swaps the contents of lhs and rhs. Calls lhs.swap(rhs).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
lhs, rhs

 -

 containers whose contents to swap
